scope: Game-design review of visible contribution per rendering cost. Read-only; no extra GPU runs or production quality cuts.

evidence.camera: Game camera vertical FOV .94 to1.09rad, depending on speed;720px height.
evidence.limits: Except grass, feature costs have not been isolated by feature-off A/B. Ranking is a review priority, not a claimed FPS saving. The real car screenshot is night/dry; weather-state conclusions also use source and prior environment QA.

priorities.visible: Blade widths6-12mm give roughly0.5-1.7pixels at5-7m with the game720p camera. Silhouettes and wind are visible close up; in the actual night-driving screenshot their contrast is low.
priorities.cost: Clock-aligned driving samples showed substantial dynamic primitive compilation and GC; immutable per-patch fix directly removes aggregate churn.
priorities.action: Keep original density, range, geometry and wind. Preserve immutable patch identity through movement and membership changes.
priorities.status: Implemented and visually reviewed; see grass-per-patch-20261021.json.

priorities.visible: Sub-millimetre to millimetre strokes are predominantly below one pixel beyond close range. Broad color/dryness variation is visible over large ground regions.
priorities.action: Preserve broad variation; inspect existing exact-zero footprint return before proposing work. Existing detail fade covers .006-.038m footprints.
priorities.cost: Not isolated after the current fixes.

priorities.visible: Leaves about9-16cm and papers20-28cm across can read clearly while walking or under headlights, while contributing little during fast night driving.
priorities.action: QA paired day/night and low-angle views first. Prefer avoiding work only when current analytic coverage is exactly zero. Keep authored wind and ground identity.
priorities.cost: Not isolated; existing footprint fade reaches zero between .035 and .2m.

priorities.visible: High value on wet roads, clear-coated vehicles and glass; lower contribution on dry rough ground.
priorities.action: Investigate exact receiver eligibility and avoid a pass only when its contribution is zero. Do not lower reflection resolution, distance or wet-road readability without paired review.
priorities.cost: Earlier720p instrumented diagnostic reflection mean about.4ms; current car GPU timing absent.

priorities.visible: Headlight and lamp bloom helps nighttime brightness cues; daylight low-emission scenes may have a smaller response.
priorities.action: Retain nighttime light appearance. Measure actual empty-source/bright-region work before changing implementation.
priorities.cost: Earlier720p instrumented diagnostic bloom passes total about.5ms; half-resolution targets already used.

priorities.visible: High contribution to contact, shape, night navigation and road depth. Missing or striped shadows are immediately visible.
priorities.action: Preserve contact and beam occlusion. Focus on redundant matrix, caster and buffer work, keeping the corrected receiver-plane PCF.
priorities.cost: Current car has two active spotlight shadows; no measured per-feature car GPU cost yet.

priorities.visible: Large visible weather changes and surface response communicate world conditions. Tiny far droplets may be below a pixel but wetness and road reflections are not.
priorities.action: Prefer exact dry/occluded/empty work elimination. Measure rain-state A/B separately; do not dilute weather to obtain a higher score.
priorities.cost: Not isolated in the dry-night car run.

priorities.visible: High value for thin grass, road paint, distant edges and camera movement; removing it risks visible shimmer.
priorities.action: Retain temporal stability and history correctness. Optimize allocation/history work instead of disabling AA.
priorities.cost: Earlier720p instrumented diagnostic TAA mean about.29ms.

acceptance: Compare the same camera/time/weather at full720p with movement and correct vehicle control. Distinguish a tiny numeric representation change reviewed in all raw images from an unreviewed quality reduction. Rare freezes remain a separate acceptance failure.
